about_the_game:
A lone samurai, driven by grief and vengeance, walks the path of blood.
His family has been torn from him—his wife slain, his daughter stolen by unknown hands. With nothing left but his blade and unyielding rage, he embarks on a relentless quest for justice. Strike down those who stand in your way, master the art of the sword, and carve your revenge into the world itself.

  • Fast-paced, skill-based combat – Use directional inputs to clash against enemies in intense duels.

  • Arcade-style challenge – No two runs are the same. Adapt, refine your technique, and push for mastery.

  • A world steeped in mystery – Travel through the land of clouds, uncover secrets, and hunt those responsible.

  • Powerful upgrades – Discover items to aid you in battle and shape your path to vengeance.

Are you ready to embrace the way of the blade?

content_descriptors.notes: Violence and gore when defeating an enemy, cutscene of enemy being slain by main character. Suicide by ritual for main character upon defeat. Rape context no visuals bare naked chest in beginning of story.
